capabilities: Sync tasks between Obsidian and Todoist (full Obsidian-to-Todoist, partial reverse)
Assign projects, sections, dates, times, durations, and priorities via inline task syntax
Add reminders, deadlines, and comments to synced tasks
Import tasks from a pasted Todoist task URL
Configure sync tag, default project, and automatic sync interval
extras: The README states it is for learning purposes only and carries a no-warranty disclaimer; some features work only for Todoist paid users; development is AI-assisted with a CLAUDE.md for contributors; several sync directions are marked '🔜' (planned, not yet implemented).
intentEvidence: This is a fork from the Ultimate Todoist Sync plugin for Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian tasks are local checkboxes with no connection to Todoist, so task changes in one app do not appear in the other.

relations.evidence: This is a fork from the Ultimate Todoist Sync plugin for Obsidian.
You can list all synchronized tasks from your Obsidian Vault using the Obsidian DataView plugin.

summary: Task sync plugin that creates, edits, and completes Todoist tasks from Obsidian notes using inline task syntax, forked from the Ultimate Todoist Sync plugin.
